method: A brace-scoped owner pass over all 175 .ts files for >=2 Boolean-valued members (S.Boolean and wrappers such as optionalKey, OptionFromOptionalKey, .pipe, withKeyDefaults; `: boolean`; Option<boolean>; true/false literals): 8 files, every owner seeded.

An alias sweep for SchemaUtils.BoolKeyDefault*/BoolDefault* (missed by literal matching): in-lane uses are Md.escape AllowListUrlPolicySpec (seeded), Md.model TaskItem.checked (single) and Table.headerRow (single).
An inferred-local pass over const/let Boolean locals by type annotation, Boolean-producing RHS or Boolean-style name, clustered by proximity: 50 clusters in 26 files, all read at the site.

An inheritance check: the Lexical BaseNode/ElementNode/TextBase bases have no Boolean fields, so each subclass carries at most one Boolean (QuoteNode.shadowRoot, ListItemNode.checked, TableNode.rowStriping).
Ontology seed legal-intake.ttl (34 lines) and legal-intake.jsonld (90 lines) contain no Boolean literals or xsd:boolean.

Md.escape.ts:125-131 BoolKeyDefaultTrue/False aliases. The docs at :100-105 declare the axes independent, and isAllowedRelativeDestination (:402-410) ANDs allowRelative with the narrower flags, so all 8 policies are legal. Minor: the canonical note cites 404-407 while the evaluator spans 402-410 (note-text only).
Html.conformance.ts:1082-1083 hasSizes (source attribute) and followingImageAllowsAuto (sibling img) are independent observations, combined only in the issue predicate.

TaxonomyLoader.ts:527 is an actual Match.value({hasLoadKind, hasLoadStatus}) object literal inside decodeLoadManifestEntry (line and symbol exact). The raw asset row (:480-481) carries two optional columns. The alignment row carries both (:183-184), a vendor row carries only status, and a plain asset row carries neither. kind-only decodes to a manifest parse error, i.e. a raw-input diagnostic, not a supported state. Priority Match.when handles combined-true, so the D1 classification is unchanged.

identity/Id.ts:1974-1995 Object.defineProperties descriptors set enumerable/writable/configurable (all true) per property; the ECMAScript descriptor attributes are independent. Kind object-literal and anchor 1976 are correct.

Html.conformance.ts:1923-1934. traditional requires every tag in option/optgroup/hr, while customizable requires sequenceTags[0]==='button'. They are mutually exclusive (empty sequence => traditional only), and the reader ORs them for a single valid/invalid grammar. The design's none/traditional/customizable literal holds.

Html.conformance.ts:1797-1829. direct = dt/dd groups directly, while wrapped requires every element child to be div or script-supporting with length>0. The two cannot both hold, so the design's none/direct/wrapped literal holds.
Html.conformance.ts:1895-1908 mixed = optionMode && (...), so mixed => optionMode (E4); the phrasing/options/mixed literal holds.
Html.conformance.ts:1856-1883. hasSrc (attribute) and valid (child-order scan that consults hasSrc) reach all four combinations.

Html.form-control.ts:264-268 is an actual constructed Match.value({hasCommand, hasCommandFor, parentIsSelect}) object in resolveAutoButtonState (line and symbol exact). The facts are independent HTML observations; Match.when explicitly handles both-true (auto-command-and-commandfor), and every combination is a legal Auto reason.
SkillCompletion.ts:327-345. uniqueResultIds and resultsMatchDeclarations are independent validation facts over raw completion input.
Html.conformance.ts:2024-2040. entersFromHtml (parent) and usesIntegrationElement (node name) are independent; the issue fires on one conjunction only.
Html.conformance.ts:1341-1362. applies (parent/attribute applicability) and hasViolation (OR of violation checks) are independent. missingRequired is an array, not a Boolean member.

Struct.ts:697-702 is an actual Reflect.defineProperty descriptor object in fromEntries (first Boolean member line 698 exact) with configurable:true, enumerable:!isBlockedObjectKey(key) and writable:true. The ECMAScript attributes are independent.
rdf/Iri.ts:306-307 isLast/hasDot are per-segment observations over raw input. hasDot on a non-last segment is a parse rejection (raw diagnostic), not a supported-state restriction.
Html.conformance.ts:1037-1042. imageSizesIncompatible (imagesizes/imagesrcset) and iconSizesMisplaced (sizes vs rel) concern different attributes and are independent.
Recovery.ts:227-275. Eight independent coherence checks over raw failure records, AND-folded; any subset can fail.
EvidenceReceipt.ts:315-330 is a filter over raw summaries. passed is derived from gateResults, and resultMatches/levelsMatch compare other stored fields against it. Each can independently fail.

Html.conformance.ts:984-1022. sourceSizeAnalysis is Some only when sizes is present, so incompatibleSizes => hasSizes and sizesIsExactlyAuto => hasSizes; missingSizes => width profile => hasSrcset && !hasSizes. missing and incompatible are exclusive, so the ok/missing/incompatible disposition literal holds (E4). The consumer (:1003-1022) emits at most one of the two issues.

Html.conformance.ts:1026-1060. imageSizesIncompatible => hasImageSizes (O.exists over the imagesizes analysis), and the missing condition (width && !hasImageSizes) is exclusive with it, so the disposition literal holds. iconSizesMisplaced is an independent axis (separate D1 seed).
